definitions.explanation: Performing a play, musical, or other stage production again after its original run has ended. Can also refer to re-performing a piece of music or replaying a role.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}ミュージカルが{再演|さいえん}される。
examples.english: The popular musical will have a revival performance.

examples.japanese: {初演|しょえん}から{十年|じゅうねん}ぶりの{再演|さいえん}が{決定|けってい}した。
examples.english: A revival has been announced for the first time in ten years since the premiere.

examples.japanese: ファンの{熱望|ねつぼう}に{応|こた}え、{演出|えんしゅつ}を{一新|いっしん}した{再演|さいえん}が{来春|らいしゅん}{上演|じょうえん}される{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: In response to the fans' passionate requests, a restaging with a fresh direction is scheduled for next spring.

notes:
USAGE:
{再演|さいえん} is a performing arts term used for stage productions (plays, musicals, operas) that are performed again. It can be used as a noun or with する. The antonym of sorts is {初演|しょえん} (premiere).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再演|さいえん}する (to revive, to restage)
- {再演|さいえん}が{決定|けってい}する (a revival is decided)
- {再演|さいえん}を{望|のぞ}む (to hope for a revival)
- {再演|さいえん}{公演|こうえん} (revival performance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {再演|さいえん}: revival performance (same production staged again)
- {初演|しょえん}: premiere (first performance)
- {再放送|さいほうそう}: rebroadcast, rerun (for TV/radio)
- {再上映|さいじょうえい}: re-screening (for films)
